name: Mavis Beacon Teaches Typing Version 8
summary:
Mavis Beacon Teaches Typing Version 8 is the 8th entry in a series of instructional typing software featuring Mavis Beacon, a fictional typing tutor.

This title uses minigames as teaching aids, teaches typing posture, stretches, and keyboard placement through a series of short-form videos, and also allows the player to test their typing speed and improve their typing skills by copying various texts, including poetry and classic literature.

The minigames in Version 8 are:

Rag Time

Space Junk

Road Race

Check-out Time

Chameleon Picnic

Shark Attack

Penguin Crossing
